## About
South Shore Bearing Distributors, Inc. supplies quality bearings, seals, drive shafts, universal joints, rear end differential parts and other machine and engine products from our counter on Copeland Street in Quincy. We serve individuals and MA businesses working on cars, trucks, agricultural equipment, industrial machinery and construction vehicles like bulldozers, dump trucks and pavers.
Our knowledgeable staff draws on decades of experience to help you find the exact machine part or engine product that keeps your equipment running smoothly. Bring in the old part, or bring the dimensions, and we'll match it. One reviewer noted the shop is passing to the next generation and the service is still top notch.
We carry a huge inventory of top-name products. Parts can be bought at the counter, or ordered by phone and shipped via UPS anywhere in the United States. Customers rate us 4.9 from 40 Google reviews.

## Services
- Roller bearings and ball bearings: Timken, Federal-Mogul, Bower/BCA and IKO precision and metric bearings for industrial, manufacturing, machine, automotive and commercial applications. Also needle, tapered and cylindrical bearings and pillow blocks.
- Oil seals & grease seals: National Oil Seals and Stemco Seals that protect important engine components for the automotive, industrial and construction industries.
- Drive shaft service & drive shaft balancing: Drive shaft and driveline parts and components from Meritor, Spicer and Neapco, plus service and balancing for shafts that wobble.
- Custom drive shafts: Steel or aluminum drive shafts built on the premises, including shafts customized to match horsepower and torque improvements on your auto, truck or racing car.
- Rear End Parts: Rear end differential parts and axle ring and pinion gear sets.
- Front & Rear Wheel Bearing Hub Assemblies: Wheel bearing hub assemblies for front and rear applications.
- Vintage Bearings & Seals: Bearings and seals for cars, trucks and equipment of all vintages, for axles, wheels, differentials, pinions, transmissions and more.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturdays and Sundays.

Q: Can I order by phone and have parts shipped?
A: Yes. You can order by phone with a credit card and we ship via UPS anywhere in the United States.

Q: Can you build a drive shaft to replace mine?
A: Yes. Bring us your old drive shaft or the dimensions of the new one and we can build it. One customer said we even explained how to measure.

Q: What bearing brands do you carry?
A: Timken, Federal-Mogul, Bower/BCA and IKO precision and metric bearings.

Q: I'm outside your service area. Can I still get parts?
A: Yes. Parts can be shipped directly to your home or business.
